title: fix(graph): print the missing virtualenv warning with err.print

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+``pipenv graph`` in a project without a virtualenv now prints the "No virtualenv has been created" warning and exits with 1 instead of failing with an ``AttributeError``.

@@ -44,7 +44,7 @@ def do_graph(project, bare=False, json=False, json_tree=False, reverse=False):
         cmd_args.append("--reverse")
 
     if not project.venv_locator.exists:
-        err.echo(
+        err.print(
             "[bold][red]Warning: No virtualenv has been created for this project yet! Consider "
             "running `pipenv install` first to automatically generate one for you or see "
             "`pipenv install --help` for further instructions.[/red][/bold]",

@@ -0,0 +1,19 @@
+"""``pipenv graph`` reports a missing virtualenv and exits with 1."""
+
+from unittest import mock
+
+import pytest
+
+from pipenv.routines.graph import do_graph
+
+
+def test_graph_without_virtualenv_exits_with_error(capsys):
+    project = mock.MagicMock()
+    project.venv_locator.python.return_value = "/venv/bin/python"
+    project.venv_locator.exists = False
+
+    with pytest.raises(SystemExit) as excinfo:
+        do_graph(project)
+
+    assert excinfo.value.code == 1
+    assert "No virtualenv has been created" in capsys.readouterr().err
